device_vm.note: the user's machine, where the repository lives
device_vm.network_egress: none; pypi.org returns HTTP 403 through the proxy

cloud_container.note: an ephemeral Linux container, used for the checks the device VM cannot perform
cloud_container.network_egress: pypi.org and api.github.com both return HTTP 403

database.how: alembic could not connect - no psycopg driver - so the full upgrade was emitted with 'alembic upgrade head --sql' in offline mode and applied through psql with ON_ERROR_STOP=1

defect_found_and_fixed.what: migration 0012 passed the full constraint name to op.create_check_constraint, and the metadata naming convention ck_%(table_name)s_%(constraint_name)s prefixed it again
defect_found_and_fixed.consequence: the check still worked, but under a name no later migration could drop
defect_found_and_fixed.found_by: applying the migration to a real PostgreSQL server; the emitted SQL reads correctly either way
defect_found_and_fixed.fix: pass the suffix and let the convention compose the name

application_runtime.how: apps.web.main:app served by uvicorn 0.46.0 on 127.0.0.1:8010 in the cloud container
application_runtime.note: a localhost process in an ephemeral container is not a staging environment and is not described as one
